note: Dispatch ('Central') and car chatter: the main heat cue (CORE_SYSTEMS). Plain-English period style; no real call signs. {placeholders} are filled by Gameplay from the witness description.

lines.text: Central to Midtown Central cars: a report of shots fired, {street} and {avenue}.
Central to Madison Square cars: assault in progress, {street} near {avenue}.
Central to Bryant Park cars: a car theft, {street} and {avenue}. Check it out.
Suspect: {sex}, {build}, {topColor} {top}, last seen {direction} on {street}.
Vehicle: {carColor} {carType}, partial plate {plate}, {direction} on {avenue}.
Witness: {sex}, {topColor} {top}, carrying a {item}. Use caution.
Description's vague, Central. A woman, dark coat. That's all we've got.
Witness says 'a guy'. Just 'a guy'. Thanks, Central.
Witness says he looked like a cop. Walked like a cop. Says he's no cop.
Heavy-set male, expensive suit, grey hair, big black sedan. Real memorable.
Central to all cars: officer down, {street} and {avenue}. All units respond.
Central, we need a second car. Suspect is armed.
Car one-four, canvass the block. Check the doorways and the subway.
Nothing on Eighth, Central. Lot of people. Lot of coats.
Central, we lost him at the station. Too many exits.
Suspect is gone, Central. Resuming patrol.
Central, cancel that. Complainant isn't sure what she saw.
Car eight, never mind that report. Sergeant says it's handled.
Central to all cars: signals dark from Twenty-Sixth to Thirty-Fourth. Watch the crossings.
Central, car six, out of service for coffee. Ten minutes.
Central, any word on overtime? …Never mind.
Central to Midtown Central: hydrant open again, Thirty-Seventh and Ninth.
Central to Midtown Central: a disturbance, {street} and {avenue}. One car.
Central: a complaint of a man acting suspicious, {street}. Take a look when you can.
Central to Midtown Central cars: suspect wanted for {crime}, last seen {street}.
Car one-four to Central: we'll swing by {avenue}. Ten-four.
Central to all Midtown cars: armed suspect, {street} and {avenue}. Approach with caution.
Central, car nine: we're setting up on {avenue}. Need another car on the corner.
Central to all cars: shots fired at officers, {street}. Every car in the sector.
Central: sawhorses at {avenue} and {street}. Nobody in or out.
Central to all precincts, all units: Midtown is closed. Every car. Every man.
Central: the captain's on the air. Find this one. I don't care how.
Car six, on foot! He's going {direction} on {street}! Over the fence!
Central, I lost him on the roofs. He's up top somewhere. Send a car to {street}.
Car eleven in pursuit, {carColor} {carType}, {direction} on {avenue}! Clear the crossings!
He went the wrong way on {street}! Wrong way! Central, warn the sector!
Car one-four responding. Two minutes.
Car nine, on our way. We're stuck behind a bus on {avenue}.
Car three, responding. If the car starts.
Central, ten-four.
Ten-four, Central. On it.
Central to Midtown Central: cancel the alarm on {street}. Suspect not located.
Central, show us back in service. Nothing doing.
Central, all cars: four-to-midnight tour coming on. Look alive.
Central to all cars: Hudson Union says an hour. Treat every crossing as a stop.
Central, car six: the lights are out at {avenue}. We're directing traffic by hand.
Central to all units: keep this channel clear. Emergency traffic only. Clear the air.
Car nine, on {avenue}, coming up on the scene now. Two minutes.
Car one-four, we're on {street}. We got the corner. Nobody's leaving.
This is the sergeant. I'm taking the air. Every car, give me your position.
Central: ambulance is rolling. Cars on {avenue}, clear them a lane.
Sergeant to all cars: you see him, you call it in. You don't go alone. Understood?

audio.filter: 1970s police two-way radio: band-limited 300-3000 Hz, squelch tail, light static; dispatcher slightly cleaner than cars

voices.sergeant: one older adult voice, gravel, slow; the hot tier only (audio may map to the car urgent register)
voices.dispatcher: one adult voice, calm, flat, fast, Midtown Central dispatch
voices.car: several adult patrol voices, rotating; breathless on foot, louder in pursuit

audio.tiers: heat1-heat5 map to Gameplay heat levels; escalate and cop_killed take over at 'officer down'; 'hot' plays in the 90 s after officer down (band clears, cars check in, a sergeant takes the air)

slots.avenue: Fifth, Sixth, Seventh, Eighth, Ninth, Madison, Park, Lexington, Broadway

audio.renderNote: For build-time voices: render each line's fixed parts once and concatenate slot words (slot lists above); or render the most common filled variants.
